up: Find all distinct compound records that have at least one activity measurement (any type) linked to the document with CHEMBL ID 'CHEMBL5725513'. Return each compound's canonical SMILES, molecular weight, and any reported activity values (standard value, standard units, and activity type) along with the standard relation (e.g., '=', '<', '>'), ensuring only records that have a canonical SMILES stored in compound_structures are included. Filter results to the specified document ID only, and preserve all related activity details without additional date or unit restrictions.
sql:
WITH target_activities AS (
  SELECT a.molecule_chembl_id, a.standard_value, a.standard_units, a.type AS activity_type, a.standard_relation, cs.canonical_smiles
  FROM activities a
  JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id
  WHERE a.doc_id = 5725513
    AND cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
),
activity_summaries AS (
  SELECT molecule_chembl_id,
         GROUP_CONCAT(standard_value || ' ' || standard_units || ' ' || activity_type || ' ' || standard_relation || ';') AS activity_details
  FROM target_activities
  GROUP BY molecule_chembl_id
)
SELECT DISTINCT
       t.pref_name,
       cs.canonical_smiles,
       cs.mw_freebase AS molecular_weight,
       s.activity_details
FROM target_activities a
JOIN molecule_dictionary t ON a.molecule_chembl_id = t.molecule_chembl_id
JOIN compound_structures cs ON a.molecule_chembl_id = cs.molecule_chembl_id
JOIN activity_summaries s ON a.molecule_chembl_id = s.molecule_chembl_id
WHERE cs.canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL
  AND a.standard_value IS NOT NULL;

up: Retrieve all distinct compounds that have at least one activity measurement linked to the document with ChEMBL ID 'CHEMBL5725513'. For each compound return its canonical SMILES (from compound_structures.canonical_smiles), its molecular weight (from compound_properties.mw_freebase, labelled molecular_weight), and a list of all activity details including the activity type (a.type), standard relation (a.standard_relation), standard value (a.standard_value) and standard units (a.standard_units) aggregated per compound. The filter must restrict activities to those associated with the document whose chembl_id is 'CHEMBL5725513' (using the docs table to map the CHEMBL ID to doc_id). No other filters (e.g., unit restrictions, activity type, confidence scores) are required. Ensure a canonical SMILES exists and the molecular weight is taken from compound_properties. The output should include one row per compound with all its activity details, and the compound rows must be distinct.
sql:
WITH doc_id_lookup AS (SELECT doc_id FROM docs WHERE chembl_id = 'CHEMBL5725513'), activity_summary AS (
  SELECT a.molregno,
         GROUP_CONCAT(a.type || ';', a.standard_relation || ';', a.standard_value || ' ', a.standard_units, ';') AS details
  FROM activities a
  JOIN doc_id_lookup d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
  WHERE a.standard_value IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY a.molregno
), molecules AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT cs.canonical_smiles,
                  cp.mw_freebase AS molecular_weight,
                  ass.details
  FROM activity_summary ass
  JOIN compound_structures cs ON ass.molregno = cs.molregno
  JOIN compound_properties cp ON cp.molregno = cs.molregno
  JOIN activity_summary ass ON cp.molregno = ass.molregno
)
SELECT DISTINCT canonical_smiles, molecular_weight, details
FROM molecules;
